project_type: Monorepo: Next.js web app (apps/web), Django API (apps/api), shared packages
test_framework: No test runner for apps/web (lint + types only). pytest for apps/api (Docker-based).
test_command: tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh types && tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh lint apps/web/core/components/service-logs apps/web/core/components/service-timesheet apps/web/app/(all)/[workspaceSlug]/(projects)/service-timesheet packages/constants/src/workspace.ts packages/i18n/src/locales
verification_instructions: 1. Run tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh types to confirm no type errors. 2. Run tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh lint on touched paths. 3. Verify i18n parity with tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh i18n.
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed. Branch feat/progress-bar-override-badge-timesheet created from preview.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. Node via nvm at /root/.nvm/versions/node/. pnpm via corepack. No Docker daemon available for API tests but not needed (frontend-only changes for items 1 and 2, item 3 timesheet uses existing API). The API test suite is NOT needed -- the timesheet endpoint already exists.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns (MobX stores for domain state, SWR for reads, Tailwind design tokens). Translations in en + pt-BR only. Use EUserWorkspaceRoles.ADMIN and MEMBER for access control. Register routes in apps/web/app/routes/core.ts. Sidebar items go in apps/web/core/components/workspace/sidebar/workspace-menu.tsx.
key_patterns: Container queries (@container, @lg, @sm) for responsive layouts inside peek. Design tokens: border-subtle, bg-surface-1, bg-surface-2, text-custom-text-100/200/300/350/400. SWR for data fetching with service classes. ServiceReportsService for API calls to /api/workspaces/{slug}/service-reports/. ServiceLogFilterSet params (author_ids, project_ids, competence_from/to) for filtering.
directory_structure: apps/web/app/(all)/[workspaceSlug]/(projects)/ contains workspace-scoped routes. apps/web/core/components/ has shared components. packages/constants/ has navigation config. packages/i18n/src/locales/ has translations. apps/api/plane/app/views/ has API endpoints.
